transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hi. Uh... I'm just having some trouble at work, I guess. I keep making these dumb mistakes on the sales reports. Like... copying the wrong numbers off the team dashboard, or just missing a line in a procedure I'm supposed to check. Even when I thought I already went over it. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you had trouble paying close attention to details or making careless mistakes since childhood?

Yeah, I guess so. My mom actually still brings up these old teacher notes from elementary school. They always said I rushed through my work... or lost my homework. And, uh, that I talked out of turn a lot. Or that I couldn't just stay in my seat without them reminding me to sit down. So... yeah. I was like this back then, too.
Did these work problems start after a specific stressful event or change in your life?
Um... not really a stressful event, I guess. Just... things changed at work. I moved into a supervisor role about a year and two months ago. It's just been more of a problem since then.
Do you have these same attention or careless-mistake problems in other parts of your life, like at home or in social situations?

Um... yeah, I guess so. It's... well, at work, my manager actually brought it up in a formal review recently. So that's not great. And, uh... at home, it causes some issues too. Just... conflict, I guess. People say they feel like they can't count on me to follow through on things. So... yeah. It happens there, too.
Do you also tend to fidget, interrupt others, or find it hard to wait your turn?

Yeah... waiting is tough. I don't know, if I'm stuck in a line, or on hold with one of our vendors, or even just... waiting for another supervisor to finish talking in a meeting... I just get impatient. Really fast. I usually just end up pushing to try and move things along. It's just hard to sit there.
